Run CPU-only preparation independently while retaining the exact control lease in manager and actor; claim only verified, ready cohorts under shared lease balancing.
Run the verified original cluster child through a separately receipted observer entry point; support historical children with and without install_progress.
Append an always-false generation observer without changing sampling kwargs, response count, existing stopping rules or optimizer.
A generation call with no returned decode step for1800s attempts stack capture and exits70; preserve prior checkpoints and do not automatically resubmit as a success.

Describe actual model/task purpose, local GPU question counts, returned answer length versus configured cap, actual per-process policy_update event counts, and time since actual token progress. Do not estimate completion or interpret generation as optimizer progress.
